issues.detail: No householder local requirements were captured. Arboricultural Assessment (BS5837): trees protected by TPO, in a Conservation Area, Ancient Woodland including its 15m buffer, or Ancient/Veteran trees. Ancient Woodland and Ancient/Veteran Trees information. CIL Additional Information Form: where gross internal floor space increases by 100 sqm or more, or for any residential annexe. Drainage Assessment: non-mains drainage. Ecology Reports (PEA and surveys): site in or adjacent to designated sites, meadows, grassland, mature trees, woodland or ponds, or alteration of rural/older buildings. FRA: Flood Zone 2/3, or Flood Zone 1 over 1ha, or other flood sources. Heritage Statement: within or adjacent to a designated area, affecting a statutory or locally listed building or its setting, or within the setting of a scheduled monument. Metropolitan Green Belt Information: any works to a dwelling or an outbuilding within 5m of it, requiring floor plans and elevations of all sides including basements. Noise Assessment: near commercial/industrial uses, main roads or railways, or where air source heat pumps or air conditioning are proposed (BS4142).
issues.evidence: Householder checklist: Metropolitan Green Belt Information - 'Any application for works to a dwelling or to an outbuilding within 5m of the dwelling'

issues.detail: No full planning local requirements were captured. Air Quality Assessment: major development, or other development over 1000 sqm. Arboricultural Assessment. Ancient Woodland / Veteran Trees assessment. CIL form: new homes, change of use to a dwelling, residential extensions and outbuildings, retail of 100 sqm or more. Contaminated Land Assessment: sites with industrial, commercial or agricultural history; Phase 1 minimum. Design and Access Statement: all new or replacement dwellings including change of use, major development, commercial of 100 sqm or more. Drainage Assessment: major, or non-mains drainage. Ecology Reports. Fire Statement: 2 or more dwellings or educational accommodation at 18m or more, or 7 or more storeys. FRA. Heritage Statement. Noise Assessment. Structural Survey: conversion of agricultural or rural buildings. S106 Affordable Housing: 10 or more units, or 6 or more in a Designated Rural Area. Financial Viability Report: where affordable housing is not proposed or policy SP3/SPD requirements are not met.
issues.evidence: Planning Permission checklist, Local Requirements: 'Affordable Housing provision required where the development proposes 10 or more residential units'

issues.detail: Eight further type-specific checklists were not read or captured: Reserved Matters, Outline and Hybrid, LDC (existing), LDC (proposed), Advertisement consent, Listed Building Consent, Variation of condition and Tree Works. All app_type rows read 'Not covered'.
issues.evidence: Planning Validation Checklists page links checklists 1-10 (file ids 4894-4903)

summary: Grokbot's link is the general 'what you need to submit' page, not the list; the current list is 10 checklist PDFs revised in September/October 2026. Grokbot wrongly marked them unreadable and captured no requirements, so all local requirements are missing, including the Sevenoaks-specific Green Belt information, Fire Statement and noise/ASHP items.
